statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-32178 is a .NET spoofing vulnerability: specially crafted data processed by System.Net.Mail is not neutralised, so an attacker can spoof content over the network. Microsoft lists every platform as affected, with the .NET 10 runtime packages up to 10.0.5 affected and 10.0.6 patched (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/390, https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/126890, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.6/10.0.6.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0 through 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. Every build carries System.Net.Mail.dll ten times on each architecture: in the shared framework of dotnet10-runtime, in the reference pack of dotnet10-targeting-pack, and in the nupkg files, packs, shared frameworks and runtime archives held by dotnet10-runtime-artifacts and dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap. Every copy has the product version of its build's .NET release: 10.0.2 to 10.0.5 in 10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.5-r0, and 10.0.6 or later in 10.0.6-r0 and every later build. The range ends at 10.0.6-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-32178 (GHSA-vmwf-m9c5-3jvc) is a .NET spoofing issue in System.Net.Mail: specially crafted data lets a network attacker spoof content. Microsoft lists the Linux runtime packs among the affected packages and fixed .NET 9 in 9.0.15 (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-vmwf-m9c5-3jvc, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.15/9.0.15.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: System.Net.Mail.dll ships in the .NET shared framework in dotnet9-runtime, in the SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and in the runtime and ILCompiler NuGet packages in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts, and every implementation copy in a build carries that build's .NET version. In 9.0.12-r0 through 9.0.14-r0 System.Net.Mail is 9.0.12 through 9.0.14, which are affected; from 9.0.15-r0 on, the version is 9.0.15 or later, with Microsoft's fix. The range ends at 9.0.15-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
